name: HTTP Header Detection
description: This module shows HTTP Headers returned by the scanned systems.

options.name: HTTP_METHOD
options.description: HTTP Method to use, HEAD or GET (Accepted: GET, HEAD)

options.name: IGN_HEADER
options.description: List of headers to ignore, separated by comma

options.name: Proxies
options.description: A proxy chain of format type:host:port[,type:host:port][...]. Supported proxies: socks5, socks5h, sapni, http, socks4

options.name: THREADS
options.description: The number of concurrent threads (max one per host)
